body:
Elementwise base4 vector ops (xor/and/or/add/subtract), vec-eq, dimlen, dot -- founder real-time direction to grow the stdlib LO needs to function, FFI-into-PARENA acceptable per design. Confirmed a real, live double-boxing compiler bug on dot (same class as linalg.prn's documented matmul/transpose bug), verified not glossed over. 24 assertions, make test-base4-vector green, -Werror clean. Matrix/pattern-match ops deliberately deferred. PARENA commit f0048e8.

⚓ ☃
title: stdlib/base4/vector.prn -- LO Phase 1 stdlib target
